class.name: IfcClassificationReference
class.brief_description: An IfcClassificationReference is a reference into a classification system or source (see IfcClassification ) for a specific classification key (or notation). The inherited attributes have the following meaning: Identification : holds the key provided for a specific references to classification items (or tables). Name : allows for a human interpretable designation of a classification notation. Loca

members.member: The classification system or source that is referenced.

Description of the classification reference for informational purposes. IFC2x4 CHANGE New attribute added at the end of the attribute list. A String, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
